planning_memory.runtime_host_guard: max(2*historical fixed512 B512 process peak, 2*new fixed1024 B512 cumulative process peak) +8GiB; initial planning number uses historical origin only
planning_memory.formula: 2*resident full workload + 3*full outputs + max linearly scaled actual compiler temporary bytes; 2GiB GPU slack; 2*observed B512 host peak + 8GiB host slack
limitations: resident upper bound doubles measured B512 collection including shared-static overhead; actual per-shape stacked bytes must replace it at startup
compiler temporary bytes and snapshots are not measured VRAM peak
host is process cumulative peak scaling, not reservation or guaranteed peak

time_basis.limitation: New B512 fixed1024 and B1024 timings are unknown. Two compiles expected with cache off; 90min is a finite ceiling, not predicted runtime.

storage.scope: two consolidated full checkpoint containers plus small manifests/reports; no per-lane/per-variable files

node_basis.selection_reason: available GPUs and 16 unallocated Slurm CPUs; lower observed CPU load than other eligible nodes with available GPUs and at least4 free CPUs; lower-load n03/n07 had all8 GPUs allocated
node_basis.limitation: scheduler snapshot, no reservation and no selected-card process evidence; inspect again before submission and record startup identity/load/affinity/inventory

latest_observation.scope: terminal raw9 parent/children plus test02 strict saved-array validation passed

primary.scope: one raw9 terminal parent row; no child rows summed

conservative.scope: one raw9 terminal parent row; no child rows summed

executable_memory_analysis.scope: compiler device buffer estimate; not host RSS or measured VRAM peak

physical_gpu.scope: selected physical GPU snapshot immediately before prospective compilation

memory_preflight.limitation: scaled actual compiler temporary buffers plus full collection overlap; estimate is not a measured peak or OOM guarantee
memory_preflight.input_byte_scope: actual pure-helper host stacks for the complete1024 collection, including shared-static layout

host_memory_preflight.limitation: max historical512-to1024 projection/current B512 process peak times2 plus8GiB; conservative planning, not measured peak or reservation

post_measurement_GPU_memory.scope: selected physical GPU snapshot immediately before prospective compilation

memory.RSS_peak_scope: process cumulative peak through this stage; before/after are actual stage boundary snapshots
memory.VRAM_scope: actual selected-card preflight/post-measurement snapshots; not a measured peak

checkpoint_IO.scope: host snapshot pickle serialization and atomic write/fsync/replace; excludes manifest/report/event writes
